The '''RCLU''' was an organization chaired by [[Dotswa Ween]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Representing the RCLU as its chairbeing, Ween appeared on a talk show called ''[[In the Political Pit]]'' at 1935 on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:11]]. The [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] issue of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that [[Standard day/Legends|day]] advertised that Ween would be joined by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Reridan Reksiss]], [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[Musician/Legends|recording artist]] [[Gaeriala Boosin]] as the show's panellists.<ref name="scan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The RLCU was mentioned in "What To Scan," a website section<ref name="scan" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #51]] on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="scan" /> on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=MattPeriolat|date=2002-04-11|time=6:19 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref>
